FN-8YP8FF-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 302
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Mack Butler
Commissions
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/18/2023
House Bill 302 as introduced could increase receipts to the Alabama Board of Electrical
Contractors Fund in the State Treasury by an undetermined amount dependent upon any
additional civil penalties issued by the board of up to $5,000 as provided by this bill.
Further, this bill codifies the current practice of the Board of examination and issuance of
provisional licenses. The provisional license fee currently set by board rule is $75, and
according to the board, there are currently 528 active and 130 inactive provisional licensees.
According to the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts, the Board collected $40,200 in
provisional license fees in Fiscal Year 2020.
